summary_md: **Alex ([@DevOuterReaches](https://x.com/DevOuterReaches/status/2116209287965942140))** releases **blender-building-generator v0.13.1**, a Blender add-on now generating full cities with points of interest and exporting metadata for Unity procgen asset placement ([outerreaches/blender-building-generator](https://github.com/outerreaches/blender-building-generator)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - outerreaches/blender-building-generator: Blender add-on that generates game-ready buildings and whole ruined cities: closed-solid shells with floor plans, damage and collapse states, points of interest, streets with driving circuits, and FBX + JSON export for Unity.
